title: A product of two smooth algebras over one base is smooth
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $S'$, $S''$ be commutative $R$-algebras, with structure maps $\psi':R\to S'$ and $\psi'':R\to S''$. Make the product ring $S'\times S''$ (componentwise operations, unit $(1,1)$) an $R$-algebra via $r\mapsto(\psi'(r),\psi''(r))$. If $R\to S'$ and $R\to S''$ are smooth ring maps [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], then $R\to S'\times S''$ is a smooth ring map.
